notes:
- Main menu music: "Main Menu" plays (and loops) on the title screen.
- Cell blocks: about a third of the cells stand open (a gap in the bars, the barred door swung back), on
  both floors, so you can walk in. A catwalk bridge across the middle joins the two upper walkways, and
  you can't jump over the railings any more (bullets still go over them).
- Co-op: when the host pauses, everyone pauses ("PAUSED BY THE HOST"). Your melee weapon now shows
  in your character's hands for everyone else.
- Smoother: fixed the sharp stutters. Building a special zombie (riot guard, bloater, stalker, screamer)
  the first time each look appeared took up to a quarter of a second; they're all built while the map loads now.
- Red dot sight: slimmer and sleeker.
- Fixed: a vertical grip on a pistol floated under the gun; on pistols it mounts under the barrel now.
- Fixed: you could stand on the ends of the gym bleachers where zombies couldn't reach you. The ends now
  follow the slope of the seats.
- Main menu: zombies that get stuck on a post step around it, and ones that wander up to the walkway railing
  topple over it, front-flip onto their backs, get up and keep coming.
